prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on what you need (brand strategy, digital/paid media, B2B, e‑commerce, creative, PR), your budget, industry and timeline.

A couple of widely recognized Kansas City agencies:
- Barkley — large, full‑service creative agency known for brand and advertising work. 
- VML/VMLY&R — global digital and experience agency with strong digital transformation and integrated marketing capabilities (originated in KC).

How to pick the best agency for you
1. Define goals and scope: branding, performance/paid media, inbound/SEO, social, B2B lead gen, etc.
2. Set budget and timeline: agencies range from boutique ($5k–$20k+/month) to large networks (six‑figure retainers).
3. Evaluate portfolios and case studies: look for work in your industry or similar objectives and measurable results.
4. Check references and reviews: ask for client contacts and metrics from campaigns they ran.
5. Look for culture/communication fit: chemistry, reporting cadence, and team structure matter.
6. Start small: pilot project or 60–90 day test before committing long term.

If you tell me:
- what you’re trying to achieve,
- your monthly/annual budget, and
- whether you want local agencies only or are open to remote/national firms,

I’ll shortlist 3–5 Kansas City agencies that fit your needs (with specialties and reasons for each). I can also draft an RFP or list questions to ask when you talk to them.
